response.text: {"label": "timing_arithmetic", "reason": "The target needs s_axis_tvalid to rise on the exact clock the stop period ends, while tready is still low. Gold raises it there (frame of 10 bits × prescale 1 × 8 cycles ends at `83 ... tx hs 3c`). The sub instead keeps tvalid high or re-raises it only after waiting for tready/idle, so the 3c load at `433 ... tx hs 3c` (same cycle as busy_fall) is never driven by a tvalid rise at the stop-end clock."}
